title: Rational elliptic surfaces with six singular double fibres
summary: A rational elliptic surface with section is a smooth, rational, complex, projective surface $\mathcal{X}$ that admits a relatively minimal fibration $f: \mathcal{X}\longrightarrow \bbP^1$ such that its general fibre is a smooth irreducible curve of genus one and $f$ has a section. In this paper, we classify rational elliptic surfaces with section that have exactly six singular fibres, each counted with multiplicity two.
